task.title: Scoped timeline state editing
task.specification: config={frames:[unique IDs],initial:object}. Maintain each frame's persistent patch, one-frame patch and optional full snapshot. edit={type:'edit',id,scope:'persistent'|'one',key,value} sets that patch field; snapshot={type:'snapshot',id,values:object} replaces that frame with a full snapshot and clears BOTH patches. insert={type:'insert',after:null|ID,id:new ID} inserts an empty frame at start when after=null, otherwise immediately after a known frame; missing after or duplicate new ID is ignored. Edits to unknown IDs are ignored. Expand in current frame order from initial: apply a frame's snapshot if present, then its persistent patch to the carried state; display a copy with its one-frame patch applied. Carry does NOT include the one-frame patch. A snapshot is the boundary of earlier persistent scope. Output {frames:[{id,values}]} in current order. Explicit 0 and null are stored values; object edits never delete fields. Insertions inherit the then-current preceding carried state. Return one output per event. State is opaque JSON, initially null. Output objects have exactly the documented keys; object key order is irrelevant, array order is significant. IDs are nonempty ASCII strings. Values are JSON scalars unless stated otherwise. Numeric values and intermediate arithmetic are safe integers; integral JSON notations such as 1 and 1.0 denote the same number, while booleans are distinct. Strings contain Unicode scalar values without unpaired surrogates. Inputs have at most 48 events and eight simultaneous identities. Ordinary instances vary values; boundary instances emphasize empty/disabled/equality/no-op states; adversarial instances reorder callbacks and interleave edits; shift instances use longer traces/more identities within the same rules. These tasks test controller state/effects only, not visual quality, browser integration or screen-reader usability.

matchedCard.label: Canal locks
matchedCard.relation: Passage between regions at different levels proceeds through an intermediate chamber. The chamber matches the entrance level before admission, is isolated while its level changes, and matches the departure level before release.
assumptions: The chamber can be isolated from each neighboring region.
Level differences and the states of the gates are observable.
matchedCard.boundary: Simultaneous open connections bypass the intermediate isolation. An unobserved level difference does not establish that opening a gate is appropriate.
matchedCard.source_fact: USACE describes raising and lowering vessels by closing lock gates, filling or emptying the chamber, and opening the gates after levels equalize.

shuffledCard.label: Astronomical interferometry
shuffledCard.relation: Separated measurements can be combined after their relative arrival paths are aligned. Different separations and orientations contribute different spatial information; fine detail and broad structure require complementary measurement coverage.
assumptions: The measurements concern a compatible signal and maintain the needed relative alignment.
The range of separations and orientations samples the structure being reconstructed.
shuffledCard.boundary: A longer separation does not supply missing measurement orientations or increase the collecting area by the same factor. Misaligned signals need not combine into an accurate reconstruction.
shuffledCard.source_fact: ESO describes compensating path delays in interferometry and reconstructing images from telescope baselines of different lengths and orientations, distinguishing resolution from collected light.

initial.explanation: Conditional rule: each event mutates only the addressed frame or inserts a new frame; output is recomputed by ordered propagation. Persistent changes affect that frame and later frames, one-frame changes affect display only, and snapshots reset both patches and the carried boundary.
initial.mapping: Target variables are ordered frame records, carried values, persistent patches, one-frame patches, and optional snapshots. The rule directly maps each event to those state variables.
initial.assumptions: Inputs obey the stated JSON and identity constraints. Values in initial and snapshots are objects of scalar values; event values are JSON scalars.
initial.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(s===null){s={init:{},f:[]};for(var k in c.initial)s.init[k]=c.initial[k];for(var i=0;i<c.frames.length;i++)s.f.push({id:c.frames[i],p:[],o:[],s:null})}function cp(o){var r={};for(var k in o)r[k]=o[k];return r}function find(id){for(var i=0;i<s.f.length;i++)if(s.f[i].id===id)return i;return -1}function put(a,k,v){for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i][0]===k){a[i][1]=v;return}a.push([k,v])}function apply(o,a){for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)o[a[i][0]]=a[i][1]}if(e.type==='insert'){if(find(e.id)<0){var n={id:e.id,p:[],o:[],s:null},at=e.after===null?-1:find(e.after);if(e.after===null)s.f.unshift(n);else if(at>=0)s.f.splice(at+1,0,n)}}else{var j=find(e.id);if(j>=0){var f=s.f[j];if(e.type==='snapshot'){f.s=cp(e.values);f.p=[];f.o=[]}else if(e.type==='edit')put(e.scope==='persistent'?f.p:f.o,e.key,e.value)}}var carry=cp(s.init),out=[];for(var i=0;i<s.f.length;i++){var f=s.f[i];if(f.s!==null)carry=cp(f.s);apply(carry,f.p);var shown=cp(carry);apply(shown,f.o);out.push({id:f.id,values:shown})}return{state:s,output:{frames:out}}}

final.explanation: Each frame stores persistent and one-frame patches, or a snapshot boundary. Every event updates only the addressed frame or valid insertion, then recomputes outputs in order: snapshots replace carried state, persistent patches propagate, and one-frame patches affect display only. Copies prevent one-frame edits and later frames from mutating carried state.
final.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(s===null){s={i:[],f:[]};for(var k of Object.keys(c.initial))s.i.push([k,c.initial[k]]);for(var a of c.frames)s.f.push({id:a,p:[],o:[],b:null})}function cp(o){var r={};for(var k of Object.keys(o))Object.defineProperty(r,k,{value:o[k],enumerable:true,writable:true,configurable:true});return r}function set(a,k,v){for(var j=0;j<a.length;j++)if(a[j][0]===k){a[j][1]=v;return}a.push([k,v])}function ap(o,a){for(var j=0;j<a.length;j++)Object.defineProperty(o,a[j][0],{value:a[j][1],enumerable:true,writable:true,configurable:true})}function pos(id){for(var j=0;j<s.f.length;j++)if(s.f[j].id===id)return j;return-1}if(e.type==='insert'){if(pos(e.id)<0){var n={id:e.id,p:[],o:[],b:null},q=e.after===null?-1:pos(e.after);if(e.after===null)s.f.unshift(n);else if(q>=0)s.f.splice(q+1,0,n)}}else{var q=pos(e.id);if(q>=0){var f=s.f[q];if(e.type==='snapshot'){f.b=cp(e.values);f.p=[];f.o=[]}else if(e.type==='edit')set(e.scope==='persistent'?f.p:f.o,e.key,e.value)}}var carry={},z=[];ap(carry,s.i);for(var j=0;j<s.f.length;j++){var f=s.f[j];if(f.b!==null)carry=cp(f.b);ap(carry,f.p);var v=cp(carry);ap(v,f.o);z.push({id:f.id,values:v})}return{state:s,output:{frames:z}}}

initial.explanation: Maintain ordered frame records with persistent patches, one-frame patches, and optional snapshots. Recompute carried state from the initial object after each event; one-frame patches affect display only. Inserted frames capture the preceding carried state at insertion time.
initial.mapping: Frames map to ordered records. Persistent edits propagate forward until a snapshot boundary; one-frame edits affect only that frame. Snapshots replace carried state and clear both patch types. Insertions capture the current preceding carried state.
initial.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated legal JSON contract. Snapshot and initial values are objects of scalar values. Unknown edits and invalid insertions are ignored.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;function cp(x){if(!x||typeof x!=="object")return x;var y={};Object.keys(x).forEach(function(k){y[k]=cp(x[k])});return y}function eq(a,b){if(a===b)return true;if(!a||!b||typeof a!=="object"||typeof b!=="object")return false;var ak=Object.keys(a),bk=Object.keys(b);if(ak.length!==bk.length)return false;for(var k of ak)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||!eq(a[k],b[k]))return false;return true}var s=null;for(var z=0;z<input.events.length;z++){var e=input.events[z];if(!s){s={init:cp(input.config.initial),f:input.config.frames.map(function(id){return{id:id,p:{},o:{},s:null}})}}var ix=-1;for(var i=0;i<s.f.length;i++)if(s.f[i].id===e.id)ix=i;if(e.type==='edit'&&ix>=0)s.f[ix][e.scope==='one'?'o':'p'][e.key]=e.value;else if(e.type==='snapshot'&&ix>=0)s.f[ix]={id:e.id,p:{},o:{},s:cp(e.values)};else if(e.type==='insert'&&!s.f.some(function(f){return f.id===e.id})){var at=e.after===null?-1:s.f.findIndex(function(f){return f.id===e.after});if(e.after===null||at>=0){var c=cp(s.init);if(at>=0){for(i=0;i<=at;i++){var f=s.f[i];if(f.s)c=cp(f.s);Object.keys(f.p).forEach(function(k){c[k]=f.p[k]})}}s.f.splice(at+1,0,{id:e.id,p:{},o:{},s:c})}}var c=cp(s.init),r=[];s.f.forEach(function(f){if(f.s)c=cp(f.s);Object.keys(f.p).forEach(function(k){c[k]=f.p[k]});var v=cp(c);Object.keys(f.o).forEach(function(k){v[k]=f.o[k]});r.push({id:f.id,values:v})});if(!eq(r,output[z].frames))return false}return true}

function cp(x){if(!x||typeof x!=="object")return x;var y={};Object.keys(x).forEach(function(k){y[k]=cp(x[k])});return y}
function solve(a){var s=a.state,e=a.event,i,j,c,r;if(!s){s={init:cp(a.config.initial),f:a.config.frames.map(function(id){return{id:id,p:{},o:{},s:null}})}}i=s.f.findIndex(function(f){return f.id===e.id});if(e.type==='edit'&&i>=0)s.f[i][e.scope==='one'?'o':'p'][e.key]=e.value;else if(e.type==='snapshot'&&i>=0)s.f[i]={id:e.id,p:{},o:{},s:cp(e.values)};else if(e.type==='insert'&&!s.f.some(function(f){return f.id===e.id})){j=e.after===null?-1:s.f.findIndex(function(f){return f.id===e.after});if(e.after===null||j>=0){c=cp(s.init);for(var q=0;q<=j;q++)if(j>=0){var g=s.f[q];if(g.s)c=cp(g.s);Object.keys(g.p).forEach(function(k){c[k]=g.p[k]})}s.f.splice(j+1,0,{id:e.id,p:{},o:{},s:c})}}c=cp(s.init);r=[];s.f.forEach(function(f){if(f.s)c=cp(f.s);Object.keys(f.p).forEach(function(k){c[k]=f.p[k]});var v=cp(c);Object.keys(f.o).forEach(function(k){v[k]=f.o[k]});r.push({id:f.id,values:v})});return{state:s,output:{frames:r}}}

final.explanation: For each event, update the addressed frame record, then replay frames in order from the initial values. Snapshots replace the carried state and clear both patches; persistent edits affect the carried state after their frame, while one-frame edits affect only that frame's displayed copy. Inserted frames capture the preceding carried state at insertion time.

initial.explanation: Maintain ordered frame records with persistent, one-frame, and snapshot layers. Re-expand from the initial object after each event; one-frame edits affect display only, while snapshots reset both patches.
initial.mapping: The timeline maps to ordered frame records, carried values, persistent patches, transient patches, and snapshot boundaries.
initial.assumptions: Inserted empty frames inherit through ordinary expansion from their current predecessor. Inputs satisfy the stated legal-value constraints.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const x of output){if(!x||!Array.isArray(x.frames))return false;for(const f of x.frames)if(!f||typeof f.id!=='string'||!f.values||Array.isArray(f.values))return false}return true}
initial.program: function cp(o){var r={};for(var k of Object.keys(o||{}))r[k]=o[k];return r}function solve(a){var s=a.state,e=a.event,c=a.config;if(s===null){s={initial:cp(c.initial),frames:c.frames.map(function(id){return{id:id,p:{},o:{},s:null}})}}var fs=s.frames,ix=-1;if(e.type==='insert'){if(e.id&&fs.every(function(f){return f.id!==e.id})){if(e.after===null)ix=0;else ix=fs.findIndex(function(f){return f.id===e.after})+1;if(ix>0||e.after===null)fs.splice(ix,0,{id:e.id,p:{},o:{},s:null})}}else{ix=fs.findIndex(function(f){return f.id===e.id});if(ix>=0){var f=fs[ix];if(e.type==='edit'){(e.scope==='persistent'?f.p:f.o)[e.key]=e.value}else if(e.type==='snapshot'){f.s=cp(e.values);f.p={};f.o={}}}}var carry=cp(s.initial),out=[];for(var f of fs){if(f.s!==null)carry=cp(f.s);for(var k of Object.keys(f.p))carry[k]=f.p[k];var v=cp(carry);for(var k of Object.keys(f.o))v[k]=f.o[k];out.push({id:f.id,values:v})}return{state:s,output:{frames:out}}}

final.explanation: For each event, update only the addressed frame or insert a valid new frame. Re-expand frames in order from the immutable initial object: snapshots replace the carried state, persistent edits modify it for that and later frames, and one-frame edits modify only that frame’s displayed copy. Outputs are freshly constructed, so transient edits never propagate.
final.program: function set(o,k,v){Object.defineProperty(o,k,{value:v,writable:true,enumerable:true,configurable:true})}function copy(o){var r={};for(var k of Object.keys(o||{}))set(r,k,o[k]);return r}function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state;if(s===null){s={initial:copy(config.initial),frames:[]};for(var i=0;i<config.frames.length;i++)s.frames.push({id:config.frames[i],p:{},o:{},x:null})}var fs=s.frames,i=-1,f;if(event.type==='insert'){if(fs.every(function(q){return q.id!==event.id})){if(event.after===null)i=0;else{i=fs.findIndex(function(q){return q.id===event.after});if(i>=0)i++;}if(i>=0)fs.splice(i,0,{id:event.id,p:{},o:{},x:null})}}else{i=fs.findIndex(function(q){return q.id===event.id});if(i>=0){f=fs[i];if(event.type==='edit'){set(event.scope==='persistent'?f.p:f.o,event.key,event.value)}else if(event.type==='snapshot'){f.x=copy(event.values);f.p={};f.o={}}}}var carry=copy(s.initial),out=[];for(i=0;i<fs.length;i++){f=fs[i];if(f.x!==null)carry=copy(f.x);for(var k of Object.keys(f.p))set(carry,k,f.p[k]);var v=copy(carry);for(k of Object.keys(f.o))set(v,k,f.o[k]);out.push({id:f.id,values:v})}return{state:s,output:{frames:out}}}
